title: pvFFTOfSelectionOverTime
body:
## pvFFTOfSelectionOverTime

ParaView's compound filter that extracts the values of selected points or cells over all time steps (as Plot Selection Over Time does) and applies a discrete Fourier transform to each resulting time series (Table FFT), producing tables for spectral plots. Connect Input to the temporal dataset and Selection to a selection-source node (e.g. pvIDSelectionSource or pvLocationSelectionSource). Use it to find dominant frequencies of probe signals such as vortex shedding; use pvPlotSelectionOverTime and pvTableFFT separately when you need the frequency column or windowing.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The compound definition disables the frequency column and uses a rectangular window and a two-sided spectrum, so rows are frequency bins without frequency labels.
- Every time step of the input is executed; long series are slow, and uneven time spacing invalidates the FFT assumption of constant sampling.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `FFTOfSelectionOverTime`. Identity: `filters/FFTSelectionOverTime`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.
